item.title: Dokploy: Open Source PaaS Alternative to Vercel, Netlify, Heroku
item.description:
Dokploy: Open Source PaaS Alternative to Vercel, Netlify, Heroku

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS) that simplifies the deployment and management of applications and databases.

🔍 Overview

  • Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
  • Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS) that simplifies the deployment and management of applications and databases.

🧩 How it works

  • Deploy any type of application (Node.js, PHP, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.).
  • Create and manage databases with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB, libsql, and Redis.
  • Automate backups for databases to an external storage destination.
  • Native support for Docker Compose to manage complex applications.
  • Scale applications to multiple nodes using Docker Swarm to manage the cluster.
  • Deploy open-source templates (Plausible, Pocketbase, Calcom, etc.) with a single click +600 Templates.
  • Automatically integrates with Traefik for routing and load balancing.
  • Monitor CPU, memory, storage, and network usage for every resource.
  • Ship container logs and host/container metrics to Grafana (Loki, Prometheus/Mimir), Datadog, New Relic, InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics, Better Stack, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch, tagged by project/environment/application.
  • Easily deploy and manage Docker containers.
  • Manage your applications and databases using the command line or through the API.
  • Get notified when your deployments succeed or fail (via Slack, Discord, Telegram, Email, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage your applications remotely to external servers.

🚀 Availability

  • Self-host Dokploy on your VPS.
  • To get started, run the following command on a VPS:

item.title: CapRover Scalable PaaS for Application and Database Deployment
item.description:
CapRover Scalable PaaS for Application and Database Deployment

CapRover is a scalable Platform as a Service (PaaS) designed as an easy-to-use app/database deployment and web server manager that automates Docker and nginx.

🔍 Overview

CapRover provides a platform for deploying applications and databases without requiring Docker or nginx knowledge. It is designed for developers who prefer writing code over managing server configurations and those seeking to reduce costs compared to services like Heroku or Microsoft Azure.

🧩 How it works

CapRover utilizes several technologies under its interface to maintain robustness and speed:

Component Purpose
Docker Swarm Containerization and clustering
Nginx Load-balancing (via fully customizable templates)
Let’s Encrypt Free SSL (HTTPS)
NetData Performance monitoring

⚙️ Key details

CapRover supports a wide range of applications and databases, including:

  • Languages/Frameworks: NodeJS, Python, PHP, ASP.NET, Ruby
  • Databases: MariaDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Postgres
  • CMS: WordPress

Key features include:

  • Web GUI for convenience and a CLI for automation and scripting.
  • Dropdown-based installation for databases like MariaDB, MySQL, and MongoDB.
  • No lock-in; applications continue to work if CapRover is removed.
  • Setup requires only the ability to copy and paste instructions from the “Getting Started” documentation.

🚀 Availability

Further details and documentation are available at https://CapRover.com/.

#PaaS #Docker #WebDevelopment #Deployment #OpenSource
